purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software system. It creates monthly business receipt detail files for medical insurance claims (労災・自賠責 — workers' compensation and automobile liability insurance), and aggregates diagnosis-category point totals. It is a large batch program that builds and edits receipt data for submission to Japanese health insurance bodies.

verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The code itself is unambiguously COBOL. The program is part of the well-known open-source ORCA medical receipt system maintained by the Japan Medical Association. The absence of COMP-3 is notable for a financial application but not disqualifying. Truncation at 16000 chars means only the header, comments, and FILE-CONTROL section are visible, but the structural indicators confirm all four divisions and substantial procedure division content.
